forecasts.line: Bostrom expects the best supercomputers to reach the lower-bound estimate of brain-simulating power at some point from 2004 to 2008.
forecasts.quote: the required computational power will be reached sometime between 2004 and 2008

forecasts.line: Bostrom suggests the understanding needed to simulate the neocortex efficiently may exist between 2004 and 2008.
forecasts.quote: the knowledge might be available by 2004 to 2008

forecasts.line: Vinge would be surprised if smarter-than-human intelligence appeared earlier than 2005 or later than 2030.
forecasts.quote: this event occurs before 2005 or after 2030

forecasts.line: Bostrom expects present silicon chip technology to run into its physical limits around 2007.
forecasts.quote: In about the year 2007 we will have reached the physical limit

forecasts.line: Nanosolar chief Martin Roscheisen estimated his nanoparticle solar films could bring solar costs down to around half a dollar per watt by 2006.
